title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 07, 2026

A prominent sunspot group is visible across the solar disk today, associated with NOAA Active Region 4549.

📍 Location: N10W13
☀️ Region: AR 4549
🔥 Recent activity: 4 C-class flares

That is a lot of freckles. ☀️

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Image: N/A
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
